note: RFC 6962 consistency proof vectors. proof is PROOF(old, D[new]) of RFC 6962 section 2.1.2 over the first new leaves, computed by the Python batch reference; every one verifies by RFC 9162 section 2.1.4.2. A generator must give each proof byte for byte, a verifier must accept each and give every probe its valid verdict. The probes are transparency-dev/merkle's testdata/consistency at commit c39fbf350a405f68571bf4c42a6a518eb0a46a4b (Apache-2.0), hex for base64.
